text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Failed againーー!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hearing a scream, I rushed over to the 
game center. The voice seemed to belong to 
Winning Ticket.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I just can't clear this interactive motion 
game! Even though using my body is my 
specialty～～!!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Haa... The monster is way too strong. To 
think even the three of us cooperating 
couldn't lay a finger on it.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Still, maybe we should head back soon? 
We've played plenty enough already!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I don't wanna give up! Let's keep trying 
until we clear it!!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Ummm, wouldn't next time be okay too?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Because! We ate delicious parfaits, bought 
tons of stuff, rode boats in the park! 
Today's been the ab-so-lute most fun 
ever!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
So I wanna end it with smiles at the very 
end too! Let's make every single memory of 
today totally awesome!!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ticket-san...! I-I'm kind of getting all 
fired up too!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Ufufu. In that case, let's retry this 
together, the three of us!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The three of them stood before the giant 
monitor. As a massive dragon appeared on 
screen, a fierce offensive and defensive 
battle began right away!

text_block_list.name: Tough-Looking Dragon
text_block_list.text: ROAAARRRRRR!!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
My magic isn't hitting...! Scarlet-san! It 
went your way!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Guh...! I'll act as the decoy like this! 
While I draw it away, regroup!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Keep your hands off Scarletーーー!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Take thiiis! FULL POWER IMPACTTTTTT!!

text_block_list.name: Tough-Looking Dragon
text_block_list.text: GYAAAAAAAARRRGH!!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...Wh-Why did you come to save me! We 
could've cleared it if you just used me as 
bait!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I don't wanna sacrifice Scarlet! If even 
one person is missing, it won't be the 
most awesome memory!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
When we look back on today, all three of 
us should be smiling! THAT'S what makes 
the best memory everーーーーー!!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Ticket-san...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
You're right! Let's clear it together as 
three!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I want to make this the best memory too! 
Let's fight, all the way to the end!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With their hearts united as one, their 
perfectly synchronized gameplay allowed 
them to brilliantly clear the game!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yay! We did it! When we combine our 
strength, we're totally invincible!!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Yes! The absolute best teamwork!! I'm so 
glad we didn't give up halfway through...!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Uwaaaahn! You guys are the absolute 
beeestーー!!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Thank youuuu soooo muchーー! I'll never 
forget today for the rest of my life! It's 
the ultimate best memory evvverーーー!!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right! To celebrate clearing it, why 
don't we all take purikura photo stickers?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Uoooohhhn! Looking back on our memories 
through photos is way too awesooomeーー!!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Ufufu. At this rate, your memory is gonna 
be preserved with a crying face, you know?
choice_data_list: Shall we calm down somewhere first?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, I want to, but the tears just keep 
overflowing out of meeeーー!!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Even with a crying face, it's totally 
fine! Tears of joy make for the best 
memory too!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Uwaaaaaahn! Spe-chan's kindness is the 
absolute beeest tooーー!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Winning Ticket took the photo stickers 
with red-rimmed eyes. It seems they 
captured a wonderful shot that perfectly 
encapsulated the emotion!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ah, well then, shall we go grab something 
to eat? I'm already starving!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Let's see, two burger sets, a mountain of 
nuggets, and... and then, and then――

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Spe-chan, amazing! I'm not gonna lose to 
you eitherrrrーー!!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
No, Spe-san's stomach is just another 
dimension entirely... Don't blame me for 
whatever happens, okay?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, completely incapacitated from 
overeating, Winning Ticket ultimately 
couldn't take any more photo stickers.
